cohort: A 25-year-old woman with drug-resistant epilepsy secondary to autoimmune encephalitis undergoing two pregnancies.
finding: Responsive neurostimulation (RNS) enabled stable epilepsy control and reduced reliance on polytherapy during two pregnancies in a woman with drug-resistant epilepsy, resulting in healthy infants with no major congenital anomalies.
followup_time: Multi-year preconception planning period and across two pregnancies
